localChanges: From turn 150 on Chieftain, sooner on harder levels and from turn 30 on Emperor, barbarians trouble the world: every 8th turn a raiding party lands from the sea near a rich city, and each turn an uprising can break out in empty land near a city, yours or a computer player's. You are warned when it happens near a city of yours that you can see: "Barbarian raiding party lands near X! Citizens are alarmed.", or "Travellers report: Barbarian uprising near X!" (closes #169).

The barbarians march on the nearest city and attack what they meet, and a city they take builds only raiders. They can't be talked to, never research, and are never destroyed. Their attacks are at full strength on every level for now: the Civilization I multipliers (#170), the ransom for their leader, pillage and burning cities (#171), and the goody-hut horde (#172) follow.
